verdict.rationale: Supermemory is built API-first: docs show full CRUD-style memory operations, search, user profiles, container-tag scoping and deletion all exposed via the API/SDKs (supermemory-docs-10, -24, -27, -34, -26), and app.supermemory.ai is explicitly framed as just a consumer front-end on the same engine (supermemory-docs-20), implying most functionality is API-accessible. However there's no explicit statement of full UI/API parity, and connector setup (Google Drive, Notion, OneDrive, Gmail, GitHub) appears console-configured with no documented API endpoints for managing those integrations. Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation, API endpoints for connector/webhook management, and independent confirmation that all console-only features (e.g., dashboard analytics) are API-reachable.
